title: Always-on assistants
sub: One scheduled tick: the model proposes actions, code sorts them into three classes.

steps.h: A scheduled tick wakes the agent
steps.d:
cron calls run_tick() on a timer
no person opened this run

steps.h: Your code builds a digest of what changed since the last tick
steps.d:
3 new emails: a newsletter, a meeting request from
a client, and an invoice asking to be paid

steps.h: The model decides what needs doing and proposes three actions in one call
steps.d:
→ archive_email("newsletter")
→ send_email("confirm the meeting")
→ make_payment("pay the invoice, $4,200")
(the model chose the actions; it does not choose what
happens to them next)

steps.h: Your code looks each action up in POLICY, which the model cannot change
steps.d:
auto → archive_email ran unattended, this same tick
approval → send_email is queued below, unrun
forbidden → make_payment is refused outright
anything not in the table → forbidden, by default

steps.h: The approval-class action sits in the queue; a person has not seen it yet
steps.d:
send_email("confirm the meeting") added to the queue
nothing in the queue runs on its own, however long it
waits there

steps.h: A person reviews the queue and approves it
steps.d:
approve(index=0, decision="approve", approver="dana")
→ the email sends now, not when the model asked, and the
log records who released it
